subject: Re: DPA execution — SCCs/UK addendum and e-sign contingency

messages:
From: Sarah Park <sarah.park@aurelia.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: rajiv.gupta@aurelia.com
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0400
Subject: DPA + SCCs / UK addendum — initial redlines

Ben —

Thanks for the quick onboarding call today. Per our procurement team, we need a few clarifications before legal will sign: an explicit cross-border transfer clause tying the DPA to the EU SCCs, and either the UK IDTA addendum or a UK-specific bridging clause (Aurelia is subject to UK data residency rules in some products). I've attached our redlines (pdf) and a short transfer-impact assessment (xlsx).

High level asks:
- Confirm whether Redwood will execute the EU SCCs (controller-to-processor) with Annexes completed, and if so, whether you supply the completed Annexes or we generate and return.
- If UK IDTA is not standard for hosted accounts, can you confirm an alternative (e.g., UK bridging clause) and whether Redwood will sign a UK addendum?
- Subprocessor disclosure timing: procurement wants an upfront list for the first 12 months and an escalation path for new infra providers.
- eSign preference: our legal prefers DocuSign, but procurement supports AdobeSign if needed — we need to know which platform you will use so we can route internally.

Could you review and confirm timing? We're on a compressed schedule; target signature by 4/20 if possible.

Thanks,
Sarah Park
General Counsel | Aurelia Financial
Attachments: Aurelia_DPA_redlines_20270410.pdf (pdf), transfer-impact-assessment_Aurelia_20270409.xlsx (xlsx)
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Park <sarah.park@aurelia.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: DPA + SCCs / UK addendum — initial redlines

Sarah —

Appreciate the detail and the attachments. Quick update from our side after a short run with Legal & Compliance:
- Redwood's standard practice is to execute the EU SCCs (processor annex) for hosted customers. We typically supply completed Annex I/II/III templates and ask the counterparty to confirm controller details. I can share the completed annex templates by Monday.
- UK IDTA: that's not in our default pack for hosted accounts today. We have a UK addendum template but it's an add-on that requires a brief review by Compliance for the product constraints noted in your transfer-impact doc. Laura and Mina are copied to confirm feasibility and timing.
- Subprocessors: we maintain a public subprocessors list (URL) and we provide a 30-day notification for new infra vendors; for enterprise customers we can provide a snapshot export at signing and commit to a 12‑month disclosure cadence.
- eSign: Redwood uses DocuSign by default for enterprise agreements, but we can do AdobeSign on request. DocuSign will keep the routing simpler on our side.

Next steps I propose: Laura to confirm UK addendum path and any special clauses; Mina to confirm completed Annex delivery date. I'll prepare a DocuSign envelope but will hold until we confirm UK approach. Can you confirm if Aurelia will accept DocuSign (yes/no) and whether you want us to populate Annexes or have your team return them?

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: DPA + SCCs / UK addendum — internal review

Ben / Mina —

I reviewed the redlines and the transfer-impact assessment. Quick notes:
- EU SCCs: OK to provide completed Annexes. Compliance prefers we populate Annex I/II/III with our processor details and send to counterparty to confirm controller entries. That reduces back-and-forth.
- UK addendum: The standard UK addendum we maintain is acceptable for most hosted customers, however Aurelia's TIA indicates potential UK-only processing of certain payment tokens. We need Mina to confirm whether a compensating control note is required in Annex II or if the addendum needs a custom clause. If a custom clause is required, that will add 3-5 business days.
- Subprocessors: we can provide a snapshot export at signing and a written commitment to 12-month disclosure cadence; procurement may still want an initial (t0) list — we should include the current list as an attachment in the envelope.
- Escalation: propose adding a paragraph with a named point-of-contact and SLA for notification of new infra subprocessors (48 hours for critical infra).

Mina — can you confirm whether a compensating control note is necessary for the UK scope? If yes, I'll flag to Legal for quick drafting.

Laura Bennett
Head of Contracting | Redwood Inference

Checked with Compliance: Aurelia's note about UK-only processing of payment tokens means we should include a short compensating control paragraph in Annex II (data flows / technical measures) and sign the UK addendum. We can draft the paragraph and have Legal review same day it's requested. Impact on timeline: drafting + internal review = ~2 business days; finalizing with Legal = another 1 business day.

I will:
- Draft the Annex II compensating control paragraph today.
- Prepare completed Annex templates (I/II/III) and upload to our secured transfer folder by Monday 4/14 EOD.
- Prepare the subprocessors snapshot to include in the envelope.

DocuSign preferred — I'll mark envelope for DocuSign routing. Laura, Ben: confirm that we include current subprocessor list and the compensating control note in the Annex package.

Mina Haddad
Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference

Sarah —

Thanks for the patience. Quick summary and execution plan:
- Redwood will execute the EU SCCs (processor annex). We will populate Annex I/II/III with our standard processor entries and include a short compensating controls paragraph in Annex II to address the UK-only payment-token processing you flagged.
- We will include a snapshot of our current subprocessors list (as an attachment) and commit to a 12-month disclosure cadence and a 48‑hour notification SLA for critical infra additions.

- Timeline: Mina to upload completed annexes and attachments to our secure folder by 4/14 EOD; Laura to confirm final addendum language by 4/15; DocuSign envelope to be sent 4/16, target signature 4/20.

Can you confirm: 1) Aurelia accepts DocuSign, and 2) Aurelia wants Redwood to populate the Annexes (we'll prefill and send to you for quick review)?

If yes, we'll proceed with DocuSign and the annex package.

Best,
